_doc: v3 settings for the aerospotter (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from aerospotter_prep.json (work dir aerospotter_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/aerospotter_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: aerospotter

source.title: C3 mobile Radar command unit
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 3, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in aerospotter_veh.json). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (aerospotter_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_l0`..) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no collapse on the shell-soup Hunter route; these hulls are clean). WHEELED, 5 axles: MC2's aerospotter is a TRACKED radar vehicle, the approved v1 source is RGriffin65's wheeled C3 Mobile Radar Command Unit and is kept (Lee to judge). The radar turntable, platform and antenna array above z 3100 are the part `radar` on a new node under the hull, pivot on the turntable axis (44, 1835 mm); the sidecar's `spin` turns it at 30 deg/s (written from aerospotter_prep.json). The front axle is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`.
